import QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.FourierBody
import QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Wiring
import QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional

/-! Bind the actual outer QFT circuit to an independently requested Fourier width
and complete interface. Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada.
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
P0 acceptance component. Complete artifact typing and the returned full-byte H
obligations remain mandatory; this inspector alone does not issue evidence. -/

namespace QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.FourierRoot
open Artifact

/-- Positive-sign, little-endian Fourier transform, with explicit final reversal.
The request is supplied independently of the proposed artifact. -/
structure Request where
  width : Nat
  interface : Interface
  deriving Repr

structure Shell where
  enter : Nat
  body : Nat
  suffix : List Nat
  deriving Repr

def project (d : Definition) : Option Shell := match d.body with
  | .sequence children => match children.toList with
    | enter::body::suffix => some ⟨enter,body,suffix⟩
    | _ => none
  | _ => none

def arity (d : Definition) : Nat := match d.body with
  | .sequence children => children.size
  | _ => 0

def aligned (request : Request) (d : Definition) : Bool :=
  decide (d.effect = Effect.unitary) && d.interface == request.interface &&
    NodeTyping.quantumOnly d.interface &&
    (wires d.interface.inputs).size == request.width &&
    (wires d.interface.outputs).size == request.width

def scan (request : Request) (d : Definition) : Nat :=
  64 + request.interface.scan + d.interface.scan + arity d

def charge (request : Request) (d : Definition) : Nat :=
  scan request d + 8 * (request.interface.charge + d.interface.charge) +
    16 * (1 + arity d) * (1 + request.width)

def routes (width : Nat) (shell : Shell) (cache : Wiring.Cache) : Option (List Wiring.Code) := do
  let enter ← (cache[shell.enter]?).bind id
  let codes ← shell.suffix.mapM (fun i => (cache[i]?).bind id)
  let suffix ← codes.foldlM Wiring.compose (List.range width)
  if enter == List.range width && suffix == (List.range width).reverse then some codes else none

structure Pending where
  body : FourierBody.Pending
  wiring : Wiring.State
  codes : List Wiring.Code
  visits : Nat
  deriving Repr

/-- Inspect the actual entry. The untrusted order schedules only the phase-free
enter/suffix; every required root must be present in the freshly computed cache.
All scans, body inspection and wiring share one remaining structural budget. -/
def inspect (artifact : Artifact) (request : Request) (order : Array Nat)
    (remaining : Nat) : Except Error Pending :=
  if remaining > 2000000 || request.width = 0 || request.width > 8 then .error .limit else
  match artifact.definitions[artifact.entry.implementation]? with
  | none => .error .invalidIr
  | some d =>
    if arity d < 3 || arity d > 16 || scan request d > remaining then .error .limit else
    let cost := charge request d
    if cost > remaining then .error .limit else
    if !aligned request d then .error .contract else
    match project d with
    | none => .error .contract
    | some shell =>
      match FourierBody.inspect artifact request.width request.width shell.body (remaining-cost) with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok body =>
        match Wiring.inspect artifact order (remaining-cost-body.visits) with
        | .error e => .error e
        | .ok wiring =>
          match routes request.width shell wiring.cache with
          | none => .error .contract
          | some codes => .ok ⟨body,wiring,codes,cost+body.visits+wiring.visits⟩

theorem aligned_fields (request : Request) (d : Definition) (checked : aligned request d = true) :
    d.effect = Effect.unitary ∧ d.interface = request.interface ∧
      NodeTyping.quantumOnly d.interface = true ∧
      (wires d.interface.inputs).size = request.width ∧
      (wires d.interface.outputs).size = request.width := by
  simpa only [aligned,Bool.and_eq_true,beq_iff_eq,decide_eq_true_eq,and_assoc] using checked

theorem project_body (d : Definition) (shell : Shell) (found : project d = some shell) :
    d.body = .sequence (shell.enter::shell.body::shell.suffix).toArray := by
  cases body : d.body <;> simp [project,body] at found
  next children =>
    split at found
    next enter middle suffix same =>
      cases Option.some.inj found
      simpa using congrArg (fun xs : List Nat => Body.sequence xs.toArray) same
    next impossible => contradiction

theorem routes_fields (width : Nat) (shell : Shell) (cache : Wiring.Cache) (codes : List Wiring.Code)
    (checked : routes width shell cache = some codes) :
    (cache[shell.enter]?).bind id = some (List.range width) ∧
      shell.suffix.mapM (fun i => (cache[i]?).bind id) = some codes ∧
      codes.foldlM Wiring.compose (List.range width) = some (List.range width).reverse := by
  unfold routes at checked
  simp only [bind,Option.bind] at checked
  repeat (split at checked <;> (try dsimp only at checked) <;> (try contradiction))
  all_goals
    cases Option.some.inj checked
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true,beq_iff_eq] at *
    exact ⟨by simp_all [Option.bind],by assumption,by simp_all⟩

theorem inspect_conditions (artifact : Artifact) (request : Request) (order : Array Nat)
    (remaining : Nat) (pending : Pending)
    (accepted : inspect artifact request order remaining = .ok pending) :
    pending.visits ≤ remaining ∧ remaining ≤ 2000000 ∧ 1 ≤ request.width ∧ request.width ≤ 8 ∧
    ∃ d shell, artifact.definitions[artifact.entry.implementation]? = some d ∧
      project d = some shell ∧ aligned request d = true ∧
      FourierBody.inspect artifact request.width request.width shell.body
        (remaining-charge request d) = .ok pending.body ∧
      Wiring.inspect artifact order (remaining-charge request d-pending.body.visits) = .ok pending.wiring ∧
      routes request.width shell pending.wiring.cache = some pending.codes := by
  unfold inspect at accepted
  split at accepted
  next exceeded => contradiction
  next bounded =>
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq,not_or] at bounded
    split at accepted
    next absent => contradiction
    next d found =>
      split at accepted
      next exceeded => contradiction
      next scanned =>
        dsimp only at accepted
        split at accepted
        next exceeded => contradiction
        next costBound =>
          split at accepted
          next invalid => contradiction
          next header =>
            have header : aligned request d = true := by simpa using header
            split at accepted
            next absent => contradiction
            next shell projected =>
              split at accepted
              next failed => contradiction
              next body bodyChecked =>
                split at accepted
                next failed => contradiction
                next wiring wiringChecked =>
                  split at accepted
                  next absent => contradiction
                  next codes checked =>
                    cases Except.ok.inj accepted
                    have bb := (FourierBody.inspect_sound artifact request.width request.width shell.body
                      (remaining-charge request d) body bodyChecked).1
                    have wb := (Wiring.inspect_sound artifact order
                      (remaining-charge request d-body.visits) wiring wiringChecked).2.1
                    refine ⟨?_,by omega,by omega,by omega,d,shell,found,projected,header,
                      bodyChecked,wiringChecked,checked⟩
                    change charge request d + body.visits + wiring.visits ≤ remaining
                    omega

structure Checked where
  artifact : Conditional.Pending
  binding : Pending

/-- A single entry point performs complete artifact checking before the named
Fourier inspection. Neither caller-provided typed flags nor reset budgets occur. -/
def checkAll (artifact : Artifact) (order : Array Nat) (request : Request)
    (wiringOrder : Array Nat) : Except Derivation.Failure Checked := do
  let checked ← Conditional.checkAll artifact order
  let binding ← match inspect artifact request wiringOrder (2000000-checked.state.visits) with
    | .error kind => .error ⟨kind,none⟩
    | .ok pending => .ok pending
  return ⟨checked,binding⟩

theorem checkAll_conditions (artifact : Artifact) (order : Array Nat) (request : Request)
    (wiringOrder : Array Nat) (checked : Checked)
    (accepted : checkAll artifact order request wiringOrder = .ok checked) :
    Conditional.checkAll artifact order = .ok checked.artifact ∧
      inspect artifact request wiringOrder (2000000-checked.artifact.state.visits) = .ok checked.binding := by
  unfold checkAll at accepted
  cases ha : Conditional.checkAll artifact order with
  | error e => simp [ha,bind,Except.bind] at accepted
  | ok pending =>
    simp only [ha,bind,Except.bind] at accepted
    cases hb : inspect artifact request wiringOrder (2000000-pending.state.visits) with
    | error e => simp [hb] at accepted
    | ok binding =>
      have same : (⟨pending,binding⟩ : Checked) = checked := by simpa [hb,pure,Except.pure] using accepted
      subst checked
      exact ⟨rfl,hb⟩

end QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.FourierRoot
